name: disciple_octopus_overlords
description: a Disciple of the Octopus Overlords, a gaunt wild-eyed cultist with tangled dark blue hair threaded with green seaweed, pale skin, a ragged teal robe with a torn hem, a purple sash with a cord and small bone charms, bare feet, an orange clay jar with a blue spiral clutched in his RIGHT arm against his side, and a curved bone-white knife with a brown grip in his LEFT hand
hands: the curved knife stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right arm, on the screen-left side, hugs the orange clay jar against his side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, wild eyes squeezed shut, tangled hair flying, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the right arm with the orange clay jar pulled out to the left, the knife arm thrown up and out with the curved knife)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the curved knife dipping, the clay jar still clutched in the other arm

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the knife arm flung up with the curved knife, the arm with the clay jar drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the curved knife lowering, the clay jar slipping
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the curved knife's point resting on the ground, the other arm hanging, the orange clay jar on the ground beside him
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the curved knife slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the curved knife lies on the ground at the lower-right; the orange clay jar lies on its side beside him; the ragged teal robe spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the tangled hair and ragged robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the curved knife and the orange clay jar on the ground beside him
